name: Venomancer: Swift Pincers strikes again on auto attacks with weapon damage plus 15% of spell power
contract: Swift Pincers 705976 is a passive whose effect 0 is aura 42 triggering 503954 at ProcChance 20, but the client data ships it without the passive attribute and with ProcFlags 0.
Its tooltip promises: auto attacks have a 20% chance to strike an additional time for Weapon Damage plus ${$503954m1+$503954ppl1+$spn*0.15} Nature damage.
503954 is a melee-class Nature NORMALIZED_WEAPON_DMG (121) whose base value is the hit's fixed bonus, so 15% of Nature spell power must reach that base value.
A normalized hit scales attack power by the weapon type: 1.7 s for a dagger, 2.4 s for other one-handers. Spider Form keeps that, as out of form.
Bloodstained Knife 3225 is a dagger and Heavy Hammer 1510 a main-hand mace; Illidari Intuition 501336 adds attack power against beasts, which the Guerrero dummy 28168 is.
The dagger's normalized attack power share is therefore 1.7/2.4 = 0.708 of the mace's in and out of form.
About 60 swings in Spider Form at 20% give about 12 strikes; none at all has a probability below 0.0002%.
